description: Siticone NetFrameworkUI is a modern UI library for .NET Framework 4.8 and above. Build fast, sleek, and high-performance WinForms desktop apps with hardware-accelerated, pixel-perfect controls—seamlessly integrated for a polished, modern experience.
releaseNotes:
Release Notes and Important Information

-- Before You Update:
- Always back up your projects BEFORE updating.
- Review changes BEFORE updating.
- Contact us if you have questions BEFORE updating.

## Please backup all your projects before updating your library.

##Enhanced UI components:
## Enhanced some UI components and added a new UI component:

1. Added new powerful event 'EnterKeyPressed' which supplies extensive data without having to manually query properties.

UI Components improved:
1. Siticone Button Textbox
2. Siticone Currency Textbox
3. Siticone Email Textbox Advanced
4. Siticone Material Textbox
5. Siticone Textbox

## Enhancements:
1. Siticone Material Radio Button.
Improved the graphics quality of this radio button variant.

## New UI Component:

# Added new expressive UI components and more.

1. Siticone Bread Crumb.
Description:
A lightweight, customizable breadcrumb navigation control for Siticone WinForms UI. Provides a modern, touch-friendly way to display hierarchical paths and improve user navigation.

2. Siticone Expressive Panel
Description:
A specialized panel that overlays a configurable skeleton loading animation (Shimmer or Pulse) over its child controls. It automatically generates "bones" based on the size and location of child elements to create a high-fidelity loading placeholder. Also supports a Virtual Mode to simulate content rows when the container is empty.

3. Siticone Expressive Loader
Description:
A highly customizable, indeterminate loading control with organic shape morphing, physics-based inertia, and extensive theming capabilities.

4. Siticone Expressive Radial Progress
Description:
A smart circular loader with advanced completion sequencing, haptic visual feedback, themes, etc.

5. Siticone Expressive Horizontal Progress
Description:
A smart horizontal expressive progress control where the track and progress expressions are mathematically locked to prevent visual discrepancies, with advanced completion sequencing, haptic visual feedback, themes, etc.

6. Siticone Expressive Button
Description:
A dynamic, Material Design 3–inspired button featuring fluid ripples, morphing shapes, and advanced interaction tracking for highly expressive UI experiences.

7. Siticone Expressive Tile
Description:
A dynamic, interactive Tile control featuring fluid ripples, 4-sided morphing shapes, and multi-directional icon support.

8. Siticone Expressive Image Button
Description:
An expressive button control featuring centered imagery, smooth state transitions, and fluid shape morphing for modern UI experiences.

9. Siticone Expressive Group Button
Description:
A dynamic, Material Design 3–inspired group button featuring fluid ripples, morphing shapes, and smooth state transitions with selection support.

10. Siticone Expressive Group Chip
Description:
A dynamic, Material Design 3–inspired group chip featuring fluid ripples, morphing shapes, and a smooth animated checkmark that flows with the text.

11. Siticone Expressive Image Group Button
Description:
A dynamic, morphing group chip button that behaves like a radio button, featuring smooth cross-fading, fluid ripples, adaptive “jelly” physics, and single selection per GroupName.

12. Siticone Expressive Toggle Button
Description:
A dynamic, Material Design 3–inspired toggle button featuring fluid ripples, morphing shapes, and distinct On/Off states.

13. Siticone Get Device Theme
Description:
Advanced system theme listener for Siticone UI. Monitors App Mode, System Mode (Taskbar), and High Contrast changes.

14. Siticone Expressive Toggle Switch
Description:
A dynamic, smooth toggle switch that delivers organic shape morphing, elastic thumb effects, and fluid state transitions, offering full control over appearance, animation timing, and interaction behavior for modern user interfaces.

15. Siticone Expressive Group Toggle Switch
Description:
A dynamic, smooth toggle switch with grouping support, organic shape morphing, elastic thumb effects, fluid state transitions, optional radio-button behavior via GroupName, and a ReadOnly mode with shake and beep feedback.

16. Siticone Snackbar
Description:
Represents a lightweight snackbar component that displays brief, non-intrusive notifications, providing contextual feedback without interrupting the user’s workflow and automatically dismissing after a short duration.
